headline: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
summary: A KVM hypervisor flaw (CVE‑2026‑99312) on AMD hosts with nested virtualization lets a guest VM read up to 127 GB of host memory, potentially exposing other customers’ data.
whyItMatters: It enables cross‑VM data leakage in cloud environments.
recommendedAction: Update to the fixed kernel version as soon as possible.

headline: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
summary: F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG‑IP vulnerabilities that could allow denial‑of‑service or remote code execution.
whyItMatters: Exploitable flaws could compromise network infrastructure.

headline: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
summary: Threat actors exploited CVE‑2026‑76466 in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization shortly after a PoC was released.
whyItMatters: The unauthenticated remote code execution can compromise internal networks.
recommendedAction: Apply Cisco’s mitigation or patch for the vulnerability immediately.

headline: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
summary: A China‑linked group used CVE‑2026‑123890, an authentication bypass in VMware vCenter, to gain admin access and steal data.
whyItMatters: The zero‑day enables full control over vCenter servers and data exfiltration.
recommendedAction: Patch vCenter Server with the latest security update.

headline: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
summary: Using spreadsheets to store company passwords leaves administrators unaware of weak, reused, or compromised credentials, increasing security risk.
whyItMatters: It exposes organizations to credential theft and unauthorized access.
recommendedAction: Adopt a centralized password management solution.

headline: N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage
summary: A breach of N-able’s server caused a major outage affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services worldwide.
whyItMatters: Customers may experience loss of email protection and service availability.
recommendedAction: Monitor service status and apply any patches or guidance from N-able.

headline: SonicWall Warns Gen 6 Firewalls Won't Get Security Patches, Even for Critical Flaws
summary: SonicWall urges customers to retire Generation 6 firewalls, which will no longer receive security patches, citing AI‑assisted attacks.
whyItMatters: Unpatched firewalls expose networks to exploitation.
recommendedAction: Replace Gen 6 firewalls or remove them from internet exposure.

headline: Microsoft now automatically installs Windows 11 26H2 on unmanaged devices
summary: Microsoft began automatically upgrading eligible unmanaged PCs to Windows 11 26H2.
whyItMatters: Unmanaged devices may receive updates without IT oversight, affecting compliance.
recommendedAction: Review update policies and consider enrolling devices in management.

headline: The Path to AI Autonomy in the SOC
summary: A survey shows 36% of large enterprises are comfortable letting AI agents act autonomously on low‑risk security tasks, rising to 60% in a year.
whyItMatters: Increasing AI autonomy will change SOC operations and risk profiles.
recommendedAction: Assess AI use cases and governance before expanding autonomy.

headline: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
summary: Microsoft released the KB5132057 Windows 11 preview update with 28 changes, including improvements to Search, Hello, and the Run dialog.
whyItMatters: The update brings functional enhancements and fixes to Windows 11 users.
recommendedAction: Install the update via Windows Update.
